theme: 经典晴空 · 高清重制
direction: 保留原版造型、配色、构图与动画，以平滑高清材质替换像素块。
typography: 沿用 native-hud / native-combo 和原字号层级
composition: 沿用原 750×1334 竖屏构图、相机、层级、四边安全区和所有控件尺寸
controls: 沿用阶梯角控件形状和原触控边界
motion: 沿用摆动、落层、居民帧率与特效时序
sound: 沿用现有 endless-music 音乐与音量

prompts.name: classic-tree
prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: production transparent 2D game sprite, classic original HD remaster.
Input image: edit target and exact shape/color reference.
Primary request: Redraw this exact classic game asset at high definition, replacing pixel stair steps and blocky shading with clean antialiased curves, crisp continuous lines and finely painted materials. This is a faithful remaster, not a redesign. Preserve subject identity, silhouette, proportions, side view, composition and color palette. Keep the original clean readable cartoon look with subtle dimensional shading.
Specific subject: the same single green deciduous tree. Broad rounded canopy, dark green shadowed lower leaves, fresh olive yellow-green light on upper foliage, narrow dark brown trunk in the same position. Refine leaf clusters into smooth rounded natural forms, no square pixel blocks. No added pot, ground, background, or glow.
Constraints: real transparent background including holes, preserve alpha. No ground shadow rectangle, no opaque backdrop, no labels, no text, no watermark, no grid, no additional props. No pixel art or voxel blocks. No diffuse glow around edges. Keep full subject uncropped with a small transparent margin.

prompts.name: classic-icons
prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: transparent sprite sheet for the classic original City Bloxx high definition remaster.
Input image: exact EDIT TARGET for silhouettes, color palette and arrangement.
Primary request: Remaster every pixelated shape into a crisp smooth high definition painted game sprite. Keep the ORIGINAL design and colors. Replace stair-stepped contours and blocky shading with smooth antialiased edges, continuous curves and subtle dimensional material shading. The result must look like the original asset rendered clearly, not pixel art.
Specific requirements: A sprite sheet with EXACTLY SIX separate icons, in the SAME uniform 3 columns by 2 rows. Top left: the gray and golden slender tower with a blank black horizontal number plate near its base, keep the number plate completely blank. Top middle: two simple golden yellow people silhouettes, same dark brown border. Top right: the same narrow gray and golden tiered skyscraper icon without a number plate. Bottom left: the same sky blue house icon with charcoal outline. Bottom middle: the same golden square retry tile with the exact white four-pane glyph from the reference. Bottom right: the same blue video tile with white play triangle and the letters AD at upper right. Text must be exactly AD, no other letters or words. Preserve exact icon identities, widths/heights and palette. Keep icons completely separated inside their cells with transparent margins.
Constraints: real alpha transparent canvas and gaps, no opaque background, no grid, no cell outlines, no labels, no watermark. Keep the same grid arrangement exactly. Do not add, omit or merge any sprite. No glow haze outside objects. No excessive fine detail that obscures the icon at small size.

prompts.name: classic-yellow-floor
prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: EXACT UV TEXTURE ATLAS for the existing 3D building mesh in City Bloxx.
Input image: edit target. It is an unfolded UV texture atlas whose coordinates MUST remain unchanged.
Primary request: Faithful classic original high definition remaster. Keep EXACTLY the same geometry, UV island boundaries, rectangular swatches, doors, windows, mullions, cornices, balcony railings, relative positions and proportions. Preserve every original color family: yellow upper floor with two balcony/window facade panels, gray limestone surrounds, bright construction-yellow walls, black/bronze window frames, blue glass. Improve crispness, antialiasing, glass reflections, fine stone/plaster material quality and subtle dimensional edge shading. Preserve the classic original look and original SATURATION and HUES, no palette redesign.
VERY IMPORTANT: no cream/ivory recoloring of gray regions and no orange recoloring of yellow walls. Bright yellow remains yellow. Cyan remains cyan. Constraints: square full-bleed UV map, no margins, no frame, no perspective or isometric building, no new shapes or decorations, no words, no text, no logo. No pixel blocks or jagged contours. Opaque square texture.
